decisions.summary: The first house is offered the free ground nearest the seat (capacity.free_seats through the seat region, at most DRY_SPELL offers)
decisions.why: Unchanged: US1 puts the first house at the seed point and the placer decides.

decisions.summary: Every standing house offers seats in a jittered ring (+/-12 deg, up to +12%) at the distance where the footprints part plus grow_gap
decisions.why: Unchanged since round 2: FR-004 as written.

decisions.summary: Standing footprint (envelope, wood seats, the yard's and beds' south reach + SUN_CORRIDOR_FT + 2 ft, the path out as grow_gap); the new household's reach its OWN lot's envelope rolled at the seat offered (household_reach: lot k's house, kura, fixtures, byre, well pocket), settled out until it clears (settled_seat)
decisions.why: Round 3's item is fixed. household_reach (growth.py) sets household_parts for the next plain household before _bundle_envelope and takes them down after, reading the house and kura from the lot as _try_place_bundle does; on the current engine the seat is settled when it is OFFERED, so k is the household actually placed. Measured here (observed 2026-10-02, method: specs/308-grow-the-cluster/reach_check.py re-run on the clone's engine as it stood after growth.py 09:01:25 and access.py 09:02:44, reference Inashiro form, 40 households, seeds 1,3,4,8,13,25): 270 grown placements, 245 unmoved, none of them exceeding its seat's reach. A second scratch harness (wrapping settled_seat and try_place) measured each grown placement's DRAWN envelope against its source house's footprint: 0 of 270 closer than grow_gap (16.0 px), the least 16.16 px (a moved one) and 17.16 px unmoved. The new household's own yard against its source house's north wall (same harness family, pre-edit engine, 4,862 offers): the least clearance on an x-overlapping north offer 70.1 px against the 39 px corridor. FR-004's never closer holds at the seat offered and, on these seeds, at the house placed.

decisions.summary: The placer's existing computed move off an overlapping neighbor is kept; a moved placement may exceed the reach its seat was spaced for
decisions.why: Not a carve-out from FR-004: the spec says every house is asked the placer's full rules, 'which decide' (US1), FR-006 forbids changing them, and the GM asked for 'something vaguely along those lines'. Measured (above): no moved placement stands closer to its source's footprint than grow_gap (25 moved, least 16.16 px). The plan's measured line is stale, though: re-running reach_check.py now gives 10 of 270 over (25 moved, worst 6.4 px), where plan line 77 and R9 say 12 of 234 (30 moved, 204 unmoved, 5.5 px). And 'moved ... by at most 5.5 px' gives the excess over the reach as the move: the moves measured here are 2.6-66.7 px. Neither changes the ruling; both must be corrected (the figures contract).

decisions.summary: Bounds from the largest house with parts, and from the roll's own limits, priced and refused in favor of the household's own envelope
decisions.why: Refusing a looser bound narrows nothing the request asked.

decisions.summary: Seats nearest the seat center first, within FORM_BOUND x the 162 ft band's diagonal; each judged by try_place
decisions.why: Unchanged: the spec's band edge case and FR-006.
